$comment: RVND governance MCP server connection descriptor. RVND is local-first: the server runs on the operator's own hardware and binds to loopback only. This file names the server the skills drive; it does not ship the server. Install RVND separately (source-available; commercial use requires a paid licence) and point the command at that checkout. The skills resolve the live tool surface at discovery time — see references/catalogue.md.

rvnd-governance.description: Local RVND governance server: Privacy Lock, oversight, Ed25519 audit chain, policy ingest, memory, and the governance workflow facade (governance_chat, governance_map, governance_kg, loop_graph, security_dashboard, officer, model_capability, governance_lane_register/list). Loopback only; fail-closed.
